eng-oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: hosted-api-us-east-1 p95 latency > 2.5s, queue growth detected across frontend queues. Current queue depth +4200 in last 10m. Investigate and mitigate.

Sara Chen: ack. looking at dashboards now https://grafana.redwood.prod/d/hosted/queues-us-east1

Sara Chen: p95 jumped from 700ms -> 2.6s in ~8m. p99 hitting timeouts. Errors show 504s and request-level throttles.

Vikram Patel: checking autoscaler logs. something odd, autoscaler appears to be stuck in crashloop on scale decisions. grabbing logs...

Vikram Patel: autoscaler log excerpt:```
2026-03-15T21:04:02Z INFO scaler: evaluate desired_replicas=8
2026-03-15T21:04:03Z ERROR scaler: scale-apply failed: ProviderError: quotaExceeded (GPU quota)
2026-03-15T21:04:03Z WARN scaler: aborting scale until quota freed
```

Lee Gomez: ok. so autoscaler is healthy but cloud quota is 0/8 GPUs available. That explains why queue keeps growing. needs immediate mitigation: 1) throttle non-critical traffic 2) route heavy traffic to dedicated pools 3) enable smaller model fallback for best-effort customers.

Sara Chen: trying manual scale up as a workaround:```
redwood infra scale --region us-east-1 --pool hosted-gpu --delta 4 --reason "incident: queue backfill"
```

Sara Chen: command accepted by control plane, but cloud provider returned: "Insufficient GPU quota for account: gpu.quota.us-east-1 = 0 of 8"

infra-bot: CloudQuotas: GPU quota reached in us-east-1. Quota used 8/8. Linked ticket: https://cloud.redwood.tickets/INC-7421

Vikram Patel: starting immediate evictions of low-priority batch jobs to free ephemeral GPUs.```
kubectl -n infer delete jobs --selector=priority=low --field-selector=status.successful!=1```

Vikram Patel: note — that will free < 2 GPUs. still short. Opening quota request to cloud support and cc'ing partner rep. Ticket INC-7421 created, ETA 45m (requested expedited).

Anna Morales: support update: multiple customers reporting degraded responses and higher error rates. Customer list (high-traffic): AcmeCorp, Healthlytics, EduGPT. Opening incidents for each; status page draft below. Severity S2 for now, escalating if errors persist.

Sara Chen: applying temporary service-level mitigations: enabling degraded mode for non-paying/free traffic and fallback model for heavy text-generation flows.```
# enable degraded routing
redwood config set hosted.degraded_mode true --scope non_paid
# set fallback model
redwood routing set-fallback --region us-east-1 --from-model "rwd-large" --to-model "rwd-medium-quant" --duration 60m
```

Lee Gomez: pushed a routing policy to split traffic: 85% routed to normal pool, 15% to fallback variant. that's preserved per-customer override for paying customers. Also triggered cache-priming for short prompts.

Sara Chen: after degraded mode + evictions, queue depth dropped from +4200 -> +1200 in 10m. p95 improved to ~1.4s but p99 still >3s. still seeing spikes.

Vikram Patel: partner rep on-call answered. they've approved temporary quota bump request to +4 GPUs in us-east-1; cloud ETA ~38m. pushing for faster.

Anna Morales: I'm drafting status page & support broadcast. suggestion: message template: "We are experiencing elevated latencies in us-east-1 due to GPU capacity constraints causing request throttles. We have activated degraded mode and are working with cloud provider to add capacity. Some customers may see higher latencies or errors. Updates every 30m." Thoughts? :memo:

Lee Gomez: looks good. add recommended mitigations for integrators: retry with jitter, lower max_tokens, set streaming to reduce timeouts.

Sara Chen: quick checklist for handoff: - degraded mode enabled - low-priority jobs evicted - quota request opened (INC-7421) - partner rep engaged - fallback routing in place - partial routing to dedicated pools

Sara Chen: I'll stay with this for next 30m then hand off to night oncall @Micah Ortiz. Micah, please take over once the quota update arrives or if p99 remains >4s.

Micah Ortiz (night-oncall): ack. I'll be on in 30m. please post runbook + known TODOs.

Vikram Patel: adding runbook snippet:```
# fast mitigation steps
1) enable fallback routing: redwood routing set-fallback ...
2) evict low-priority jobs: kubectl delete jobs --selector=priority=low
3) throttle open/free-tier keys: redwood rate-limit update --plan free --rate 10r/s
4) request manual quota bump with partner rep and monitor cloud quotas
```

Sara Chen: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.prod/runbooks/hosted-gpu-capacity.md :point_up: adding incident notes there.

Anna Morales: support notifications scheduled every 30m. I'll coordinate customer comms. If quota ETA slips beyond 60m, escalate to S1.

eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: p95 resolved to 1.4s after mitigations; monitoring for p99. next update 21:40Z.

Lee Gomez: thumbs up to team. once quota is provisioned we'll need to rollback degraded mode and monitor for regressions. also plan a retrospective to examine pre-warming and quota thresholds.

Micah Ortiz (night-oncall): taking over. Sara, leaving any live console links and logs in thread will help. good handoff. :thumbsup:
